decisions.reason: The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer builds directly on the firm's core marking and coding expertise, so it can interpret early market feedback and improve the product through its own R&D.
The numbering software module extends the firm's existing software portfolio for variable-data inline printing, so it is cheap to maintain and draws on knowledge the firm already holds.
The inkjet coder for non-absorbent surfaces applies the firm's established ink and printhead know-how to a closely related use, so the firm can absorb customer feedback and refine it.
